bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_SEARCH_PREFLIGHT\n'
printf 'WORKDIR='; pwd
printf 'CHECKOUT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CHECKOUT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'CHECKOUT_DIRTY='; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" && echo NO || echo YES
printf 'BOT_IMAGE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'BOT_RUNNING='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}'
printf 'BOT_RESTARTS='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}'
printf 'SEARCH_GATE='; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(*) || ':' || COALESCE(bool_and(enabled),'false') FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='search'"
printf 'SEARCH_SESSIONS='; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc 'SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_search_sessions'
printf 'MENU_SEARCH_TOKENS='; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM board_menu_entry_tokens WHERE feature='search' AND enabled=TRUE AND expires_at>NOW()"
printf 'SEARCH_RUNTIME_READY='; docker logs --tail 120 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -c 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || true
